scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:diffs && npm run lint:age && npm run lint:rust
scripts.lint:js: biome check --error-on-warnings --diagnostic-level=warn static/*.js desktop/frontend desktop/*.mjs desktop/diffs-build/*.mjs tests && node desktop/check-js.mjs
scripts.format:js: biome check --write --diagnostic-level=warn static/*.js desktop/frontend desktop/*.mjs desktop/diffs-build/*.mjs tests
scripts.check:diffs: cd desktop/diffs-build && npm ci && node check.mjs
scripts.lint:rust: cd desktop && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets
